statuses.DIRECT: Obtained from source data with the same (or a documented compatible) definition as the Earth criterion.
statuses.DERIVED: Obtained through an additional documented modelling step beyond the Earth definition.
statuses.PROXY: A stand-in defined by rule, not a measurement of the target; identical for many targets.
statuses.MISSING: A compatible product exists in principle but was not assembled for this target.
statuses.INCOMPATIBLE: The Earth quantity has no physically compatible counterpart at this target.
statuses.UNVALIDATED: A value was computed but failed or has not passed a quality check; not used for scoring.

slope.earth: GMTED2010 30″, Horn slope on a 926.6 m baseline, cell mean
slope.planet: MOLA 463 m / LOLA 118 m DEM binned to 926.6 m, Horn slope, 55.6 km window mean
slope.why: Identical algorithm, baseline and statistic; different source DEMs.

surface_roughness.earth: SD of 926.6 m elevations in the cell
surface_roughness.planet: SD of 926.6 m-binned elevations in the window
surface_roughness.why: Identical algorithm and statistic; window (55.6 km) ≈ Earth cell N–S size.

lst_diurnal_range.earth: MODIS Aqua split-window LST, ~13:30 minus ~01:30 local time
lst_diurnal_range.planet: Surface brightness temperature T(13–14 h) − T(01–02 h) local (true) solar time
lst_diurnal_range.why: Same local-time definition; different instruments and retrievals (MEDA TIRS, REMS GTS, Diviner bolometric vs MODIS LST).

annual_temperature_range.earth: NASA POWER T2M warmest-month minus coldest-month mean
annual_temperature_range.planet: Rover air temperature: max − min of 12 Ls-bin (30°) diurnal means
annual_temperature_range.why: Both annual ranges of near-surface air temperature; Mars 'months' are 30° Ls bins (~56 sols); rover point vs 55 km cell.

aridity.why: Not a measurement; identical for every Mars and Moon target, so it cannot distinguish targets.

elevation.planet: 'thin atmosphere' rule: highest valid Earth cell
elevation.why: Planetary elevations use unrelated datums; the proxy value is identical for every target.

incompatible_examples.product: Diviner level-4 global maps of noon (hour12) and midnight (hour00) temperature
incompatible_examples.reason: Different local times from the MODIS 13:30 / 01:30 definition; not used for the thermal criterion.

incompatible_examples.product: Planetary absolute elevation (MOLA areoid, LOLA sphere)
incompatible_examples.reason: Different vertical datums from Earth EGM96; reported, never compared.

1.label: CATALOG VERIFIED
1.meaning: Location identified and verified; required target data not assembled.

2.label: PARTIAL DATA AVAILABLE
2.meaning: Some measured criteria (typically terrain only); other dimensions missing or incompatible.

3.label: ANALYTICALLY COMPARABLE
3.meaning: At least three directly measured criteria compatible with the Earth stack.

4.label: REPRODUCIBLE TARGET
4.meaning: Analytically comparable, and every value is produced by a documented script from checksummed source data.

readiness_rule: L1: no DIRECT criterion; L2: 1-2 DIRECT; L3: >=3 DIRECT; L4: L3 and no UNVALIDATED value (every value produced by a documented script from checksummed source data). PROXY criteria never count. L1 targets never enter any ranking.

kinds.named_feature: IAU-named feature sampled by a 55.6 km window at its gazetteer centre point
kinds.defined_region: A target region defined by ASTERRO (explicit centre / offset / extent)
kinds.mission_region: A landing or exploration region anchored at a published mission coordinate

normalisation.method: [min, max] over valid Earth cells and every atlas target value with status DIRECT or PROXY (src/compute/normalization.py::compute_ranges, unchanged)
normalisation.default_rule: Default for every atlas comparison: [min, max] over valid Earth cells and THIS target only, so a target's ranking never depends on which other targets are catalogued (lunar ΔT ~280 K would otherwise compress the thermal criterion for every Mars target). The catalogue-wide table above is offered as an alternative.
normalisation.note: Distinct from the baseline normalisation; atlas comparison scores are not baseline Analogue Scores.

gazetteer.dataset: Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature, center points (Mars, Moon)
gazetteer.processing: exact name match (diacritics fall back to clean_name)
gazetteer.limitations: Center points are single coordinates; extents are bounding boxes, not outlines.

dem_mars.dataset: MGS MOLA DEM mosaic global 463 m (USGS Astrogeology)
dem_mars.provider: USGS Astrogeology Science Center (PDS Imaging Node / Annex mosaic)
dem_mars.crs: simple cylindrical (equirectangular) on a sphere, R = 3396.2 km
dem_mars.processing: 55.6 km window, block-binned to 926.6 m azimuthal-equidistant grid, Horn slope, SD roughness (src/data/ingestion/terrain.py::planet_window, unchanged)
dem_mars.quality_flags: bins_filled / 3600 per window; band read mode near poles / antimeridian
dem_mars.checksum: SHA-256 of each extracted window grid (per target) + object ETag
dem_mars.license: NASA / USGS planetary data products; U.S. Government work, generally not subject to copyright in the U.S. Cite the product. (Licence not restated by the provider page.)
dem_mars.limitations: Window statistic; sub-window variability only in the 60x60 grid; DEM interpolation artefacts at high latitude.

dem_moon.dataset: LRO LOLA Global LDEM 118 m, March 2014 (USGS Astrogeology)
dem_moon.provider: USGS Astrogeology Science Center (PDS Imaging Node / Annex mosaic)
dem_moon.crs: simple cylindrical (equirectangular) on a sphere, R = 1737.4 km
dem_moon.processing: 55.6 km window, block-binned to 926.6 m azimuthal-equidistant grid, Horn slope, SD roughness (src/data/ingestion/terrain.py::planet_window, unchanged)
dem_moon.quality_flags: bins_filled / 3600 per window; band read mode near poles / antimeridian
dem_moon.checksum: SHA-256 of each extracted window grid (per target) + object ETag
dem_moon.license: NASA / USGS planetary data products; U.S. Government work, generally not subject to copyright in the U.S. Cite the product. (Licence not restated by the provider page.)
dem_moon.limitations: Window statistic; sub-window variability only in the 60x60 grid; DEM interpolation artefacts at high latitude.

diviner_polar.dataset: LRO Diviner level-4 polar hourly bolometric temperature maps (Williams et al. 2019, JGR Planets 124, 2505-2521, doi:10.1029/2019JE006028)
diviner_polar.provider: UCLA Diviner team (J.-P. Williams); PDS-archived counterparts exist
diviner_polar.version: files as listed with ETag / Last-Modified
diviner_polar.processing: window mean over bins valid at both local times of T(13-14 h) - T(01-02 h); mean of summer and winter
diviner_polar.quality_flags: bins valid at both local times / window bins
diviner_polar.license: NASA mission data product; licence not stated by the provider; cite Williams et al. (2019)
diviner_polar.limitations: Bolometric brightness temperature, not MODIS split-window LST; polar seasons only (2 of 4); permanently shadowed areas dominate some windows.

diviner_gcp.dataset: LRO Diviner Global Cumulative Products (GCP), DATA_SET_ID LRO-L-DLRE-5-GCP-V1.0, PRODUCT_VERSION_ID 1 (_002 files); Williams et al. (2017) Icarus 283, 300-325
diviner_gcp.provider: NASA PDS Geosciences Node (Washington University in St. Louis)
diviner_gcp.resolution: 0.5 deg x 0.5 deg x 0.25 h local time
diviner_gcp.processing: per 0.5-deg bin: mean of valid 0.25-h tbol records with 13<LT<14 minus 1<LT<2 (>=2 of 4 valid each); window value = mean over bins whose centres fall inside the 55.6 km AE square
diviner_gcp.quality_flags: >=2 of 4 quarter-hour records valid at each local time
diviner_gcp.license: NASA PDS archive product; licence not restated; cite Williams et al. (2017)
diviner_gcp.limitations: 0.5-deg bins are coarse relative to the 55.6 km window (few bins); cumulative average over all seasons; bolometric brightness temperature, not MODIS split-window LST.

rems.dataset: MSL REMS Modeled RDR (MODRDR), volume mslrem_1001
rems.provider: NASA PDS Atmospheres Node (REMS team: CAB, Spain)
rems.version: product versions as listed per sol
rems.period: sols 1-669 (every 2nd available sol; one Mars year)
rems.processing: Same aggregate() as the Jezero MEDA baseline; Ls by Mars24 from label times (validated against Mars 2020 PDS4 label Ls to 0.001 deg and the Mars24 worked example).
rems.quality_flags: GTS confidence bytes 2,3 (still, no shadow); ambient confidence bytes 7,8; strict variants reported
rems.license: NASA PDS archive product; licence not restated by the provider
rems.limitations: Single rover location; REMS GTS / boom ambient sensors differ from MEDA TIRS / ATS; Mars year 31-32 (2012-2014).

gmted_subcell.processing: Same pixel-to-cell mapping and Horn slope as the baseline stack; per-cell histogram

grids.note: Row 0 = north edge of the azimuthal-equidistant window (y = +27.8 km); column 0 = west edge; 926.6 m bins. Thermal dT grids for polar lunar targets: window means of T(13-14 h) - T(01-02 h) per bin.

subcell.note: Fractions of 30-arc-second pixels per cell with Horn slope <= X deg; percentiles from a 0.25-deg histogram.

source.method: row 32//2 of every 32 rows, mean of 32 columns
source.units: m (relative to the product datum; context only, never compared)

basemap_mars.use: Context only; never used in any comparison.

source.method: row 64//2 of every 64 rows, mean of 64 columns
source.units: m (relative to the product datum; context only, never compared)

basemap_moon.use: Context only; never used in any comparison.
